dm_granted: ✅ You received the {role} role on the {guild} server from {giver} for {minutes} minutes.
dm_removed: ✅ Your role named {role} has been removed on the {guild} server.
dm_failed: 📭 The DM didn't go through (the member has DMs closed).
bot_needs_manage_roles: The bot is missing the Manage Roles permission on this server.
already_permanent: {member} already has {role} permanently — you can only give a role as temporary if they don't have it yet (otherwise it would be lost when it expires).
full: A server can have at most {max} active temporary roles.
dangerous_web: This role grants dangerous permissions — on the web you can only give it as a member of the server with the matching Discord permissions.
log_gave_up_title: ⚠️ The temporary role can't be removed
log_gave_up: {role} ← {member}: the bot gave up after {attempts} attempts ({error}). Remove it by hand, and check that the bot's role is above it and that it has the Manage Roles permission.
web_extended: The {role} role of {member} now expires in {minutes} minutes.
web_not_found: This temporary role is no longer tracked (it expired or was removed).
web_no_member: The user isn't on the server.
web_bad_duration: The duration must be between 1 minute and 365 days.
web_module_off: The temporary roles module isn't running.
